mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Prime Speaker Zegana: "Prime Speaker Zegana enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is
# the greatest power among other creatures you control. When Prime Speaker Zegana enters, draw
# cards equal to its power."
# The counters: EtBState's initial_counters (B14's "enters with" form, FDN Goblin Boarders), X as
# M21 Carrion Grub's QProp(Selector, POWER, MAX) over other creatures you control. The draw: the
# ETB trigger with M21 Conclave Mentor's "equal to its power", QProp('source', POWER).
enters_with = EtBState(
    initial_counters=(
        (
            CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
            QProp(
                referent=Selector(
                    count=QUnbounded(),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                            FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
                field=QPropField.POWER,
                agg=QAgg.MAX,
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
draw = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {
        'amount': QProp(referent='source', field=QPropField.POWER),
        'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
    }),
)
abilities = [enters_with, draw, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Prime Speaker Zegana enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the greatest power among other creatures you control.
When Prime Speaker Zegana enters, draw cards equal to its power.

mapping.notes: EtBState initial_counters with X = Carrion Grub's QProp(Selector, POWER, MAX) over other creatures you control; ETB draw of QProp('source', POWER) (Conclave Mentor's 'its power'). Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/prime_speaker_zegana_counts_your_other_creatures.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/prime_speaker_zegana_alone_draws_one.json.
